caseName: Brotherhood of Maintenance of Way Employes v. United States
caseNameFull: Brotherhood of Maintenance of Way Employes v. United States
attorneys: James L. High-saw, Jr. and William G. Mahoney for applicants., Solicitor General Rankin and Robert W. Ginnane for the United States and the Interstate Commerce Commission, and Ral-ph L. McAfee, John H. Pickering and Richard D. Rohr for Erie-Lackawanna Railroad Co., in opposition.

opinions.text: An application was made to Mr. Justice Stewart for an order staying the decree of the three-judge district court in this case insofar as it terminated a temporary - restraining order previously entered. The application was referred by Mr. Justice Stewart to the Court. In the light of the representations made by Erie-Lackawanna Railroad Company, the application is denied without prejudice to its renewal upon the prompt docketing of the appeal.
